_comment: Files under src/ that import child_process but are NOT required to call requireTrustedWorkspace themselves, because they are helper modules only ever reached through a command that already gated on trust. Each entry needs a reason. Do NOT add a command handler here to go green — gate it instead. See scripts/verify-trust-gated.mjs.

allow.preview/openmcNative/detect.ts: Interpreter/cross-section probe. Reached only via the trust-gated Render/Verify commands (preview/openmcNative/panel.ts, verify/panel.ts). Uses execFile with array args (no shell string); the python/crossSections settings it reads are in package.json restrictedConfigurations, so an untrusted workspace cannot supply them.
allow.preview/openmcNative/exportGeometry.ts: OpenMC geometry export helper. Reached only via the trust-gated Render command (preview/openmcNative/panel.ts). Uses execFile with array args (no shell string).
